name: Login decision
intent: Allow a login exactly when an account exists, its password matches, and it is not locked. Prove both acceptance and rejection in the production Go function.
non_goals: Database lookup and password hashing correctness
JWT signing, HTTP integration, rate limiting and timing guarantees
Termination of arbitrary programs; Gobra establishes the specified partial correctness

requirements.text: Accept exactly existing, password-matching, unlocked accounts.
The production Go call returns expected results for the boundary cases.

trusted_boundary.assumption: The caller supplies truthful lookup, password-check and lock-state booleans. The example test checks wiring cases, not real database or cryptographic implementations.
